statement: AMD's 10-Q says two named customers, OpenAI and Meta, each intend to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD data center GPUs under multi-year agreements signed in October 2025 and February 2026.
why: Two buyers carrying multi-gigawatt intentions means a large slice of AMD's future accelerator volume rides on a very small number of decision makers.

impact.mechanism: Multi-gigawatt intent from two customers underwrites accelerator demand and downstream power and datacenter needs, while concentrating the risk that one customer's schedule change moves the whole line.

evidence.excerpt: In October 2025 and February 2026, we entered into multi-year agreements with OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI) and Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta), respectively, under which each customer intends to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD data center GPUs.

confidence.basis: Verbatim overview text from AMD's Form 10-Q, a primary filing.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 3; sources: AMD Investor Relations, AMD Investor Relations (SEC Form 10-Q)
